newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES DULL SESSION MIXED.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES DULL SESSION MIXED.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted mixed against hard currencies after a lifeless Wednesday interbank session, and dealers said it only registered movements against most units in reflection of overseas market activity.
"It was a very dull day and the dollar didn't do anything today," said one.

"The local dollar has been trading steadily within a 25 cent range since the beginning of the week. I think the market is still adjusting to the new one-point (bid/offer) spread (against the key U.S. dollar)," added another.
"The central bank seems to be happy with the current levels because they haven't intervened," he said.
At Wednesday's close, the local unit was quoted at 10.9500/9600 against the U.S. dollar, where it opened in the morning, but this was slightly up from late Tuesday's 10.9525/9625.

It also finished firmer on the mark at 6.6300/6500 compared to 6.6700/6900, but lost ground against sterling to 17.8000/8200 from 17.7400/7600, tracking the U.S. dollar's losses on that unit overseas.
Against the rand, it was also indicated weaker at 2.4400/4600 versus 2.4200/4400. -- Stella Mapenzauswa, Harare Newsroom +263-4 72 52 28/9 (c) Reuters Limited 1997
